decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that stayed visible after launch and fits the firm's stated direction, it likely still has option value and low enough carrying cost to retain.

Although it appears to have lost some prominence from 2023 to 2024, it remains on the website as a multi-variant product close to the core salami business, so management would likely keep it while demand potential is not fully resolved.
This newly launched organic sausage extends an established category and was given its own page in 2024, so uncertainty is still unfolding and the cost of keeping it is likely modest.
This new multi-variant organic chicken breast line directly supports the firm's expansion in organic assortments and should be kept while the market response becomes clearer.
As a 2024 launch close to the core salami offer, it is still an inexpensive option to hold on the market, though with somewhat higher risk than the more strongly signaled organic lines.
